# Atlas decision catalog

The catalog's `Standing` column and each decision record's `Standing` field are
joint lifecycle authorities. `Adopted` means current and binding for agent work;
`Replaced` means historical and requires following the record's `Follow-on`
link. Descriptive filenames have no status meaning.

| Key | Standing | Subject |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [ARC-07](./store-readings-on-each-node.md) | Replaced by [ARC-12](./retain-complete-telemetry-history.md) | Store readings on each node |
| [ARC-12](./retain-complete-telemetry-history.md) | Adopted | Retain complete telemetry history in object storage |
